problem: Find the remainder when $17^{2026}$ is divided by $1001$.
solution: Write $1001 = 7 \cdot 11 \cdot 13$. $\varphi(7)=6$ and $2026 \equiv 4 \pmod{6}$, so $17^{2026} \equiv 3^{4} \equiv 4 \pmod{7}$; $\varphi(11)=10$ and $2026 \equiv 6 \pmod{10}$, so $17^{2026} \equiv 6^{6} \equiv 5 \pmod{11}$; $\varphi(13)=12$ and $2026 \equiv 10 \pmod{12}$, so $17^{2026} \equiv 4^{10} \equiv 9 \pmod{13}$. problem: Find the remainder when $\sum_{k=1}^{2029} k^{5}$ is divided by $11$.
solution: The value of $k^{5} \bmod 11$ depends only on $k \bmod 11$, so the terms repeat with period $11$. One full period sums to $0 \pmod{11}$. Since $2029 = 184 \cdot 11 + 5$, the sum is $\equiv 184 \cdot 0 + \sum_{k=1}^{5} k^{5} \equiv 0 + 3 \equiv 3 \pmod{11}$. The answer is $\boxed{3}$.
